string.text: Help me, brother... Got a medkit? Don't leave me here.
Here, take this medkit. Get well.
Thanks, you saved me! I can't pay you, but I know a stash. I've marked it on your PDA.
Thanks for the medkit! I wanted to share a stash, but it looks like you already know the place.
Thanks for helping. I still owe you a stash location. Remind me a little later.
You promised me a stash location.
Feeling better already. Thanks for stopping.
Just a moment... Let me catch my breath.
Take care. I have to go.
The stalker marked a stash on your PDA in thanks for the medkit.
